name: Ascension
audio: birdsong swelling into a warm choir, rustling leaves and a deep, gentle dragon call; no speech
world: The glade is alive: petals, leaves and spores drift, blossoms open, vines uncurl, butterflies and fireflies rise into the shafts of golden light and the heart-tree's boughs sway.

actions.beat: The heart-tree's boughs bloom all at once, petals and spores lifting into the golden light.
{{She}} plants the staff and opens {{her}} free hand skyward as roots and flowering vines surge up around {{her}} and the seed-orb blossoms into a tree of light.
A spiral of petals rises around {{her}} as Sylvanya rises among the boughs behind {{her}}, and {{she}} turns a serene, radiant look to the camera.

notes: The Holo edition in motion: her ascended moment with the dragon and the world moving around her.
